integrity: The original 1994 Sprott article was inspected in full through authorized institutional access, including the complete Case N table entry and its surrounding discussion. The exact polynomial stationary algebra and equilibrium were replayed from the packaged rational-arithmetic checker. The conditional-law and support-rigidity arguments were independently reconstructed from generator identities and invariant-support tangency. Unavailable plausible sources are retained as explicit residual risks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures, not arbitrary unbounded trajectories.
The exact correlation is a stationary moment constraint and does not determine the complete invariant density.
The complete Panchev 2004 paper was not securely available for full-text comparison.
The complete Case N portion of the Starkov-Coria 2005 periodic-orbit localization paper was not available.
A differently phrased or non-indexed stationary moment identity could remain unlocated.
title: Universal stationary correlation and deep height excursion in Sprott N
